_comment: Full-wave reference cases for the physics-based via model. Lengths in mm, frequencies in GHz. Read by fullwave/via_case.py (Palace model) and src/physics/fullwave.ts (Impedora model). Edit here only.

cases.title: One plane pair, four stitching vias
One thick plane pair, two stitching vias
One plane pair, a single stitching via on one side
One plane pair, no stitching vias (the return current spreads into the planes)
Four planes (three cavities), lossy dielectric, four stitching vias
Differential pair, one plane pair, two stitching vias, lossy dielectric
Via with a stub: port at the third plane, open stub through a 1.2 mm plane pair
Microstrip launch: 0.5 mm pad 0.2 mm above the top plane, 0.7 mm antipad, one plane pair
cases.open: Microstrip launch: measured band by band, not a pass/fail check. The launch counts as checked up to 20 GHz (docs/VALIDATION.md).
